representation: BGE-M3 Title+Abstract+K12; K12 selected using each paper's predefined keyword
k_estimation: K-means inertia elbow by maximum endpoint-chord distance; candidate must pass frozen numeric validation
small_group_rule: A group receives k=1 only when it cannot form two clusters satisfying max(absolute minimum 3, ceil(0.15 * n)).
human_validation_requirement: At least two reviewers for non-Design-Theory keyword groups
topic_interpretation_method: adapted class-based TF-IDF over fixed cluster assignments
